value.rationale: For a three-session finite observing budget with a natural two-distinct-transit requirement, the threshold 3/4 in independent success reliability determines whether spreading phase coverage can ever outperform same-phase redundancy; the exact length threshold 1/(2d) and saturation at 2/3 resolve the full optimization over continuous calendars. It is a motivated decision criterion under transparent astronomical idealizations.
